data.exact_reserve_text: Within the calendar year technical result, a surplus of GBP 3.8m (2017: deficit of GBP 2.0m) relates to the reassessment of net claims incurred for previous accident years.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's gross opening claims outstanding at 1 January 2018 was GBP 267.622m (balance sheet prior-year column). The report states a net surplus of GBP 3.8m in the calendar year technical result relating to the reassessment of claims for previous accident years (a net prior-year release). No explicit gross prior-year movement amount is disclosed in the notes; a gross claims development triangle is provided but the report quotes only the net prior-year reassessment. Accordingly the prior-year development recorded here uses the explicit net figure (release of GBP 3.8m).
raw_causal_phrases: Within the calendar year technical result, a surplus of GBP 3.8m (2017: deficit of GBP 2.0m) relates to the reassessment of net claims incurred for previous accident years.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening reserves taken from balance sheet (claims outstanding, prior-year column). The report provides an explicit net prior-year reassessment (surplus GBP 3.8m) but does not state a gross prior-year movement; per extraction rules the net figure is used as a last-resort fallback. A gross claims development triangle is present (page 32) but the published notes do not provide a clear gross 'movement in prior years' summary; triangle was partly parsed but some cells were ambiguous in the source text. LOB movements above are year-end outstanding changes (2018 vs 2017) not explicitly labelled as prior-year-only movements.
